targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(visitor_id) FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT uniq(session_id) FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count() FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT round(countIf(hits = 1) * 100.0 / count(), 1) FROM (SELECT session_id, count() AS hits FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY session_id)

SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, count() AS pageviews, uniq(visitor_id) AS visitors FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT path AS landing_page, count() AS session_starts, uniq(session_id) AS unique_sessions FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND visitParamExtractBool(event_data, 'is_new_session') = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY path ORDER BY session_starts DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT channel, sum(pageviews) AS pageviews, uniqMerge(sessions_state) AS sessions FROM clickpulse.daily_sources WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT concat(utm_source, ' / ', utm_medium) AS source_medium, utm_campaign, sum(pageviews) AS pageviews, uniqMerge(sessions_state) AS sessions FROM clickpulse.daily_sources WHERE site_id = '$site_id' AND utm_source != '' AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY source_medium, utm_campaign ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 10

list.name: site_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM clickpulse.analytics_events ORDER BY site_id
